title: One step puts a transition on every cut
goal: The transitions mock offers Apply to every cut on a transition, so a person who wants a dissolve on each of the twenty cuts in a screen recording does it once instead of twenty times. Premiere has the same thing: select the clips and press its default-transition key.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-transitions.html #efxMenu (Apply to every cut / Set as the default transition). Building blocks from one-key-puts-the-usual-transition-on-the-cut-at: PhotonzDocument.transitionCuts(), ClipCut.fitted(_:), DefaultTransitionStore, EditorState.applyDefaultTransition. Several cuts as one step: see addTransition(_:layerID:atCuts:) which already batches joins of one clip.
acceptance: Right click on a tile in the transition picker offers Apply to Every Cut, and it puts that transition on every cut on the timeline that can pay for it, as one undo step
Cuts that cannot pay for it are left hard, and the canvas says how many were skipped
Command T with several clips picked puts the default transition on every cut between and inside them
A walk at Next defaults proves it and an audit carries a real picture
